{{Quote|My MP droids are equipped with advanced holochannel scramblers. We can speak more freely than over an open channel.|Oteg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''MP-series protocol droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] employed by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]] as messengers. MP droids, such as [[MP-77]], were equipped with holochannel scramblers and facial scanners for authentication.
